patient._comment: 'patient' contains the three sections that may be exposed in the detailed patient display: presentation, answer, and clinical.

presentation._comment: The immutable patient evidence package available for triage. Panel context controls whether other sections are locked or available.
presentation.quote: Nine malls this week. I thought it was the kids sitting on me, but it's like a truck is parked on my chest and my left arm has gone dead.
presentation.triageNote: 62-year-old male with forty minutes of crushing central chest pain radiating to the left arm, sweating and nauseated, with pain still ongoing.

answer._comment: The authoritative game answer. Explicit ESI, destination, and destination rationale are answer-bearing content; the player's assignment remains session state.
answer.destinationReason: ESI 1 is appropriate because ongoing ischemic chest pain with bradycardia, blood pressure 94/58, diaphoresis, and nausea suggests impaired perfusion requiring immediate cardiovascular stabilization.

clinical._comment: Display-ready clinical interpretation derived from patient.presentation. It preserves clinical meaning but must not explicitly name or identify the correct ESI level or destination; it does not participate in scoring.
clinical.summary: This patient has an acute inferior-coronary pattern with hypotension and bradycardia, raising concern for right-ventricular involvement.
clinical.acuityReason: The low pressure and slow rate accompanying ongoing pain indicate instability and require simultaneous resuscitation and reperfusion activation.
expectedResources: Careful medication selection because of preload dependence
keyFindings: Forty minutes of crushing central pain
redFlags: Ongoing ischemia with hypotension and bradycardia
teachingPoints: Inferior infarction with right-ventricular involvement may be highly preload dependent.
Vasodilators can worsen hypotension when right-ventricular filling is compromised.

possibleDiagnoses: Inferior myocardial infarction with right-ventricular involvement
possibleClinicalOutcome.disposition: Immediate stabilization and coronary reperfusion would be followed by intensive cardiac admission.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.
aiImageGeneration.who: a white 62-year-old man with a real white beard, in a red Santa suit with the jacket unbuttoned and the hat in his lap, seated on a blue padded clinic chair
aiImageGeneration.pose: sitting heavily, one clenched fist pressed to the centre of his chest
signs: a clenched fist held against the centre of the chest
sweat running down a pale grey face
aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character. Match the painterly STYLE of the attached reference image - its brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting and palette - but do NOT copy its cropping, camera distance or composition. FRAMING (follow exactly): a full-body WIDE SHOT, square 1:1, 3/4 front view, subject centred. The ENTIRE figure must be inside the frame from the top of the head to the soles of both feet, and the ENTIRE chair must be inside the frame including all four chair legs meeting the floor. Leave clear empty margin on all four sides - roughly 10% of the image width as space above the head and below the feet. This is NOT a close-up, NOT a bust, NOT a head-and-shoulders portrait, NOT a cropped view: the camera is pulled well back so the whole person and the whole chair sit comfortably inside the picture with room around them. Draw the COMPLETE body - head, neck, torso, both arms, both hands, lap, both legs, both feet with shoes. Nothing cropped by the edges, no missing or truncated limbs, no body part fading out or left unfinished. Subject: a white 62-year-old man with a real white beard, in a red Santa suit with the jacket unbuttoned and the hat in his lap, seated on a blue padded clinic chair. Pose: sitting heavily, one clenched fist pressed to the centre of his chest. Expression: grey-faced and frightened, brow furrowed. Clearly visible: a clenched fist held against the centre of the chest; sweat running down a pale grey face; an unbuttoned red Santa jacket. Overall: seriously unwell and frightened. No text, no logos, no watermarks, no border.
